notes.title: Rainbow Billy - MAJOR UPDATE - Patch 1.2 + New Price!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36186064/d4881cb703810b495f86666269d2fe4d81402c30.png[/img]

Hello friends!

Some very exciting news today as we push out Patch 1.2 for Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan!

Patch 1.2 is a significant one - it includes a variety of new features [b]AND[/b] (to top it off) it's paired to a new, permanent price of [b]19.99$USD![/b]

Patch 1.2 trailer:
[previewyoutube=tziqfT0YZXE;full][/previewyoutube]

Patch 1.2 notes:

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*]New Zones: Challenge yourself with three new puzzles. They're probably the hardest in the game, so be warned! 
[*]New Thoughts: 10 new thoughts can now be found in the world. They come with new upgrades too!
[*]New Creature Dialogues: You'll now find some of your friends in the world, interacting with each other. This expands on the relationships between the creatures and also provides some new lore!
[*]New Endgame Carnival
[*]A Jukebox!
[*]Theater in Star Harbor for cinematics
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*]Accessibility feature: Low Saturation
[*]Accessibility feature: Invert X Axis on Boat
[*]Completion Helper Minimap Indicators
[*]Theater in Star Harbor to replay cinematics
[*]In-Game photo filters (play the game with the filters on!)
[*]Thoughts will now say their lines upon pickup
[*]Fishing spot on Minimap
[*]Many bug fixes
[/list]

Despite the pandemic and the 2nd lockdown here in Quebec, we've managed to continue working on our little game, to fix a few bugs and add on fresh features - some even created from community feedback! We hope you enjoy what we've been working on :)

If you'd like to talk about the game or just join a wholesome group of people, [url=https://discord.gg/JAuN6UR4RS][b]join our discord community[/b][/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/WeAreManaVoid][b]follow us on Twitter[/b][/url]!

From everyone at ManaVoid Entertainment,

Thank you for your time and have a great week!

notes.title: Rainbow Billy - Content Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36186064/5cd885922248dca33ae4d7e1281024fd6c8471bd.png[/img]

Today we release our first update! This update focuses mostly on bugfixes and quality of life improvements based on user feedback! Here's a quick overview :

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3][b]Major Fixes[/b][/h3]

- Fixed Achievement "Practice makes Perfect". Player who already succeeded more than 50 QTEs perfectly will be awarded this achievement the next time they perfect a QTE!
- Gathered Thoughts will not make any sound anymore!
- Fixed possible issues when saving and reloading the game at very specific moments.
- You can now pet the dog during the end sequence!

[h3][b]Minor Fixes[/b][/h3]


- Performance improvements when traveling the Sea.
- Fixed spelling mistakes in French.
- Made QTE Hold Inputs visual more accurate.
- Fixed clipping in Fishing UI and added wide screen support.

[h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3]

- Fishing Spots with unique items are now shown on the compass.
- Diary now tells you when the last save happened.
- New WASD Input mapping option for keyboard. You can change which set of inputs is going to be used in prompts in the Diary (Arrow Keys, WASD, Xbox, Playstation or Switch!)


[h2]What's Next[/h2]

That's it for now! Expect more content in the next updates! If you'd like to participate and vote on the next features that will be implemented, be sure to 
[h3][url=https://discord.gg/tzBGJhNP]Join us on Discord![/url][/h3]

notes.title: Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's been a week already since we released our game worldwide. Let me type that again because I'm not sure I fully understand what I wrote:

We made a game that's been released WORLD. WIDE.

We still can't really believe that the game is out. The love and support we've received is quite extraordinary and we can't thank you enough for being with us the whole way!

One week in and we already have an 80 Metacritic score (which is absolutely huge for an indie developer)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FHXjNuu.png[/img]

and multiple outlets praising the game (to quote a few):

“When thinking about what makes Disney films so good I always come back to one conclusion. It’s that they can be enjoyed by both kids and adults alike. In many ways, Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan is the video game equivalent of that. It has the colors and wholesome humor that kids will love but enough gameplay depth for adults to get sucked in too.”
90 – PC Invasion

“Rainbow Billy is a fun and wholesome gameplay experience that’s sure to satisfy anyone with its bright, vibrant charm and tender coming-of-age narrative.”
85 – Cultured Vultures

"Its charm is undeniable, and developer ManaVoid Entertainment managed to create an experience that held a smile on my face from start to finish."
80 - Playstation Universe

Photos from launch day at ManaVoid HQ:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xEB1Zbs.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dr1DcTF.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5PbgB78.jpg[/img]

As indie developers, we rely on every last crumb to be able to project our game into the gaming universe in hopes of it getting talked about and played by the masses. If you'd like to go above and beyond for us, please feel free to leave a Steam review, talk about us on social media or even just mentioning us to your friends and coworkers can go a long way!

We realize that we still have some minor bugs to assess (shoutout to those of you who joined the Discord server to point them out and help us!). Our discord server remains open and is still the best way to get in touch with a dev if you're experiencing any type of issues in-game or with your console. If you are not able to join a discord server, please write to support@manavoid.com with a description of your bug and we will get to you as soon as we can!

[url=https://discord.gg/JAuN6UR4RS][img]https://i.imgur.com/1fAD37N.png[/img][/url]

We want to thank you all a billion times over - it's been quite the journey.

From Steamboat Billy to Rainbow Billy,  a team of 3 to a team of 20 (at one point), winning the Ubisoft Indie Series, pitching to publishers, landing Skybound Games, moving to a new office, invited to be a part of the Indie Mega Booth at PAX East and being nominated for Best in Show, a pandemic taking over the world, figuring out how to develop a game with a team remotely, a fire in our new office that flooded our floors with an inch of water, Wholesome Direct + E3 showcase - we've been through quite a lot. The most important part was that you all stuck by us and supported us until the end.


Thank you. Thank you for your continued support and for believing in a small indie studio from Montreal, Quebec, Canada who had a small idea but dreamt big. If we're here today delivering this game to the world, it's thanks to you.

We hope (through this little game of ours) to bring you happiness and that you enjoy every last second of it just like we did. Being an indie developer is a lot harder than people think. We're incredibly proud of our team and the work and love they've put into this game. We're confident that you'll see this and we can't wait for you all to play it!

- The ManaVoid Dev Team

notes.title: New Rainbow Billy Demo
notes.content:
A new Demo is now up on Steam! While it is almost the same in content, it is much closer to what the Game will be like. If you already played the Demo, you'll see it's very similar.

Here are a few important changes : 

 - This demo is designed so you can keep your savefile for the main game ! You won't have anything to do, just booting the main game will grab the correct save file ! If you played the old demo, we recommend that you clear your save file, just to be safe !

Here is how to delete your old savefiles: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1106830/discussions/0/2956041222219627875/


- This demo should run better than the other one! If your computer fits the min specs of the game and you couldn't run the old demo, give it a try and reach out to us in the forums!

- A bunch of little fixes from your feedback, Thank you 🙂

Happy gaming!
